title: Trump Threatens Direct US Strikes on Yemen as Saudi-Houthi War Escalates
detail: A Google News-aggregated report says President Trump threatened direct US strikes on Yemen as the Saudi-Houthi war escalates. The underlying outlet and the exact wording of the threat were not independently confirmed; treat as unverified pending primary-source or wire confirmation.
confidenceReason: Single aggregator headline; original outlet not resolved.
